name: @entur/kix-notifications-client
description: Typed client, signature verifier, idempotent inbox contract and suppression policy for Entur's journey notification webhooks. No Firebase dependency.

scripts.pretest: node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); const files = fs.existsSync('test') ? fs.readdirSync('test').filter(file => file.endsWith('.test.mjs')) : []; if (files.length === 0) { console.error('No test/*.test.mjs files found'); process.exit(1); }"
